title: QUIC RFC 9000 Client Address Validation Token Lifecycle Work Item
summary: Add internal client-side retained-token plumbing for NEW_TOKEN-derived Initial tokens while keeping Retry tokens immediate-use only.
planned_changes:
- Add an internal retained address-validation token model with source, endpoint, version, and one-attempt consumption rules.
- Consume an applicable retained token during client settings capture.
- Forward the consumed token through client host bootstrap into the runtime handshake bootstrap event.
- Encode the consumed token in client Initial packets for the attempt.
- Clear retained Initial tokens when Retry is received so Retry tokens are used only for immediate replay.
- Add direct requirement-home tests and canonical trace links for the selected S8P1P3 requirements.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, run the focused S8P1P3 token lifecycle requirement-home filter, regenerate the QUIC requirement coverage triage, and validate canonical SpecTrace JSON.
out_of_scope: Server-side validation or discard behavior for Initial packets with address-validation tokens.
Token expiration metadata and encrypted token contents.
A public address-validation token cache API.
Benchmark-suite changes for existing Initial packet formatting paths.
completion_notes: Completed as an internal client-side token selection and Initial-token encoding slice. Remaining S8P1P3 server validation and token policy requirements stay open for follow-up work.
